ruleDefinitions.name: System Control Panel Item Loaded From Uncommon Location
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects image load events of system control panel items (.cpl) from uncommon or non-system locations which might be the result of sideloading. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\hdwwiz\\\.cpl$") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\appwiz\\\.cpl$")) AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\.*") OR ImageLoaded = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\WinSxS\\\\.*")))
